构造地貌的形成 · 3D 互动课件: Formation of Tectonic Landforms · Interactive 3D Lesson
人教版选择性必修 1「自然地理基础」· 第二章第二节「构造地貌的形成」（p.26: PEP Elective 1 "Foundations of Physical Geography" · Chapter 2, Section 2 "Formation of tectonic landforms" (pp.26–32)
青藏高原上为什么会找到阔叶树的叶子化石 —— 什么力量把地表抬起来、又把它切开？: Why are fossil leaves of broadleaf trees found on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau? What force lifted the surface, and then cut it apart?
强大的挤压力让岩层塑性变形 → 波状弯曲: Powerful compressive force makes rock layers deform plastically → wavy bends
向上拱＝背斜、向下弯＝向斜；核部岩层老、两翼新: Arched up = anticline, bent down = syncline; core rocks are older, limbs younger
背斜顶部受张力裂隙多、侵蚀快 → 地形倒置: The anticline crest under tension has many fractures and erodes fast → inverted relief
力超过限度 → 断裂并沿断面明显位移（水平 / 垂直）: Force beyond the limit → fracture with clear displacement along the plane (horizontal / vertical)
上升岩块成断块山、下降岩块成谷地；断层沿线破碎成沟谷: Raised blocks form fault-block mountains, dropped blocks form valleys; broken rock along faults forms ravines
岩层向上拱起的那一段（轴部）: The stretch where the layers arch upward (axis)
岩层向下弯曲的那一段（槽部）: The stretch where the layers bend downward (trough)
竖直断面两侧岩层沿走向错开: Layers on either side of a vertical fault plane offset along strike
两条平行断面切出的三块、交替升降: Two parallel fault planes cut three blocks that rise and fall alternately
岩层为什么会弯成波状？: Why do rock layers bend into waves?
把「挤压力」从 50 % 拖到 100 %，看岩层拱得更高、弯得更深: Drag "compressive force" from 50 % to 100 % and watch the layers arch higher and bend deeper
振幅 60 → 120 m；曲率由 ±14.8 变到 ±29.6（10⁻³ m⁻: Amplitude 60 → 120 m; curvature goes from ±14.8 to ±29.6 (10⁻³ m⁻¹, positive for anticlines, negative for synclines); anticline axis 340 → 400 m, syncline trough 220 → 160 m, height difference 120 → 240 m
向上拱＝背斜 · 向下弯＝向斜: Arched up = anticline · bent down = syncline
岩层的变形和变位称为地质构造，褶皱和断层是常见的两种。: Deformation and displacement of rock layers are called geological structures; folds and faults are the two common kinds.
在地壳运动产生的强大挤压力作用下，岩层会发生塑性变形，产生一系列波状弯曲。: Under the powerful compressive force of crustal movement, rock layers deform plastically, producing a series of wavy bends.
挤压越强、振幅越大：50 % → 100 % 时振幅 60 → 120 m，两处: The stronger the compression, the larger the amplitude: at 50 % → 100 % the amplitude goes 60 → 120 m and the height difference 120 → 240 m.
去掉这一步：学生不知道山为什么是「弯」出来的，也读不出曲率符号。: Skip this step and students won't know why mountains are "bent" into being, nor read the curvature sign.
常考：褶皱的成因是「强大挤压力下的塑性变形」，不是「岩层被拉断」。: Common exam point: folds are caused by "plastic deformation under powerful compression", not "layers being pulled apart".
在强大的挤压力作用下，岩层发生塑性变形、产生一系列波状弯曲，叫作褶皱；背斜向上拱: Under powerful compressive force, rock layers deform plastically into a series of wavy bends called folds; anticlines arch up and synclines bend down (curvature signs opposite).
facts A2.2 #1（p.27）；B2.1 ②、B3 第 1 / 3 行、: facts A2.2 #1 (p.27); B2.1 ②, B3 rows 1 / 3, B4 D1/D3/D8
背斜和向斜，凭什么分得出来？: How can anticlines and synclines be told apart?
点一下「背斜轴部」那一列岩层：面板亮出轴部与同一褶皱的两翼各出露第几层: Click the column of rock at the "anticline axis": the panel shows which layer is exposed at the axis and on the two limbs of the same fold
剥蚀到 2.0 Ma：背斜轴部出露第 5 层、同一褶皱的两翼出露第 6 层（层号: Eroded to 2.0 Ma: layer 5 is exposed at the anticline axis and layer 6 on both limbs of the same fold (smaller numbers are older); axis eroded 100 m, limbs 40 m; height difference still +60 m (not inverted)
①最老 ⑦最新（教材图 2.15 图注）: ① oldest, ⑦ youngest (textbook Fig. 2.15 caption)
背斜岩层向上拱起、向斜向下弯曲，曲率符号一正一负。: Anticline layers arch upward and syncline layers bend downward, with opposite curvature signs.
但只看形态不够：剥蚀以后形态会倒置，得看层序。: But shape alone is not enough: after erosion the shape can be inverted, so look at the sequence.
判据是同一褶皱里核部与两翼比：轴部出露第 5 层、两翼第 6 层，层号小的是老—: The test compares the core and limbs of the same fold: layer 5 at the axis, layer 6 on the limbs, and the smaller number is older; core old, limbs young, so this is an anticline.
去掉这一步：学生会只按「山上就是背斜」判，倒置以后全判错。（向斜是「核部新、两翼: Skip this step and students judge only by "on a hill means anticline", getting it all wrong after inversion. (A syncline is "core young, limbs old", explained from Fig. 2.15; this lesson's model only gives layer readings for the anticline side)
易错：认为背斜一定「中间新」或说不清新老——判据是核部与两翼比层号。: Common mistake: thinking an anticline is "young in the middle" or being unclear about ages; the test is comparing layer numbers of the core and limbs.
背斜核部岩层老、两翼新；判背斜还是向斜，要把「向上拱 / 向下弯」的形态和核部与: In an anticline the core rocks are older and the limbs younger; to tell anticline from syncline, look at the shape (arched up / bent down) together with the core-versus-limb sequence.
facts A2.2 #1/#3/#6（p.27 图 2.15 图面 + 图注）: facts A2.2 #1/#3/#6 (p.27, Fig. 2.15 and caption), A5 #8; B2.1 ③, B4 D7
背斜明明是山，怎么成了谷？: An anticline is clearly a hill. How does it become a valley?
把「剥蚀时间」从 0 拖到 4.5 Ma：盯住「背斜轴部 − 向斜槽部」的正负: Drag "erosion time" from 0 to 4.5 Ma, watching the sign of "anticline axis − syncline trough"
高差 120 → 60（2.0 Ma）→ 0（4.0 Ma，临界）→ −15 m: Height difference 120 → 60 (2.0 Ma) → 0 (4.0 Ma, critical) → −15 m (4.5 Ma, inverted); axis eroded 225 m, trough 90 m; layer 2 exposed at the axis, layer 5 at the trough
背斜顶部因受张力产生裂隙，容易被侵蚀成谷地。: The anticline crest develops fractures under tension and is easily eroded into a valley.
向斜槽部受挤压、岩石致密，不易被侵蚀，相对高耸形成山岭。: The syncline trough is compressed and its rock dense, resisting erosion, so it stands relatively high as a ridge.
高差 dh 由正变负的那一刻就是倒置临界：4.0 Ma 两处等高，4.5 Ma: The moment the height difference dh turns from positive to negative is the inversion threshold: at 4.0 Ma the two are level, and at 4.5 Ma the anticline is 15 m lower.
去掉这一步：学生会把「背斜成山」当铁律。: Skip this step and students treat "anticlines form hills" as an iron rule.
易错：说倒置是因为「背斜顶部被压塌」——教材写的是张力裂隙 → 易被侵蚀。: Common mistake: saying inversion happens because "the anticline crest collapses under pressure"; the textbook says tension fractures → easily eroded.
外力长期作用下会地形倒置：背斜顶部受张力、裂隙发育、被侵蚀成谷；向斜槽部受挤压、: Under long-term external forces relief can invert: the anticline crest under tension fractures and erodes into a valley; the syncline trough under compression has dense rock and stands relatively high as a ridge.
岩层被切开以后，怎么错开？: Once the layers are cut, how do they shift?
断层类型已置为「水平位移」：把「水平错距」拖到 200 m，看同一层在断面两侧错: Fault type is set to "horizontal displacement": drag "horizontal offset" to 200 m and see how far the same layer is offset across the fault plane
同层错开量 100 → 200 m；断面两侧同层同号、断面处不留缝也不重叠；褶皱: Offset of the same layer 100 → 200 m; the same layer has the same number on both sides, with no gap or overlap at the plane; fold readings (amplitude, height difference) unchanged
水平位移：岩层被错断，不升降: Horizontal displacement: layers offset, no rise or fall
当岩层受到的力超过所能承受的程度，岩层就会断裂并沿断裂面发生明显位移，称为断层。: When the force on rock layers exceeds what they can bear, they break and shift clearly along the fracture plane: this is a fault.
断层的位移方向有水平和垂直两种；以水平方向为主时，岩层在水平方向上被错断。: Fault displacement can be horizontal or vertical; when mainly horizontal, the layers are offset horizontally.
错距是这把尺子：错距 100 → 200 m，同一层在断面两侧也错开 100 →: The offset is the ruler: offset 100 → 200 m, and the same layer is offset 100 → 200 m across the plane.
去掉这一步：学生把断层一律理解成「上下错动」。: Skip this step and students take every fault to be "moving up and down".
易错：认为断层只有上下错动——位移方向有水平和垂直两种。: Common mistake: thinking faults only move up and down; displacement can be horizontal or vertical.
以水平位移为主的断层，使岩层在水平方向上被错断：同一层在断面两侧沿走向错开，错开: A fault with mainly horizontal displacement offsets the layers horizontally: the same layer is shifted along strike on either side of the plane, by the horizontal offset.
岩块上下错动，会长出什么地貌？: When blocks move up and down, what landforms grow?
断层类型已置为「垂直位移」：把「断层落差」拖到 160 m，看三块岩块一升一降: Fault type is set to "vertical displacement": drag "fault throw" to 160 m and watch the three blocks rise and fall
上升岩块抬升 30 → 80 m、下降岩块下切 −30 → −80 m、相邻岩块: Raised block up 30 → 80 m, dropped block down −30 → −80 m, height difference between neighbors 60 → 160 m (= the fault-block mountain's relative height)
上升块成山 · 下降块成谷: Raised block forms a mountain · dropped block forms a valley
以垂直方向为主时，岩块交替升降：前块与后块上升、中间那块相对下降。: When mainly vertical, blocks rise and fall alternately: the front and back blocks rise and the middle one drops relatively.
上升的岩块经风化侵蚀常成为断块山或高地（华山、庐山、泰山）；相对下降的岩块常形成: Raised blocks, after weathering and erosion, often become fault-block mountains or highlands (Huashan, Lushan, Taishan); relatively dropped blocks often form valleys or lowlands (Weihe Plain, Fenhe Valley).
落差就是断块山的相对高度：60 → 160 m。: The throw is the relative height of the fault-block mountain: 60 → 160 m.
去掉这一步：华山、渭河平原这类例子没有画面依托，还容易把断块山说成褶皱山。（断层: Skip this step and examples like Huashan and the Weihe Plain have no picture to rest on, and fault-block mountains get mistaken for fold mountains. (Rock along a fault is broken and easily weathered and eroded, often developing into ravines and rivers)
易错：把华山、庐山、泰山说成褶皱山；把渭河平原、汾河谷地说成流水侵蚀谷。: Common mistake: calling Huashan, Lushan and Taishan fold mountains; calling the Weihe Plain and Fenhe Valley valleys eroded by running water.
以垂直位移为主的断层：上升岩块常成为断块山或高地，下降岩块常形成谷地或低地；断层: A fault with mainly vertical displacement: raised blocks often become fault-block mountains or highlands, dropped blocks valleys or lowlands; rock along the fault is broken and easily develops into ravines and rivers.
考核：把断层调成水平位移并错开 ≥ 120 m，同时保持背斜处高于向斜: Check: set the fault to horizontal displacement with an offset of ≥ 120 m, while keeping the anticline higher than the syncline
想办法同时满足三件事：断层是水平位移、同层错开至少 120 m、背斜轴部仍高于向: Find a way to meet three conditions at once: the fault is horizontal displacement, the same layer is offset at least 120 m, and the anticline axis is still higher than the syncline trough
达标的一组：挤压力 60 %、剥蚀 2.0 Ma、水平位移、错距 120 m →: One passing setting: compression 60 %, erosion 2.0 Ma, horizontal displacement, offset 120 m → height difference still positive (not inverted), same layer offset 120 m; other solutions are accepted too
先看「两侧岩层是错开还是升降」：错开＝水平位移，阶梯＝垂直位移。: First check "are the layers on either side offset or stepped": offset = horizontal displacement, steps = vertical displacement.
再判背斜向斜：形态（拱 / 弯）+ 层序（核部老 / 新）。: Then judge anticline or syncline: shape (arched / bent) + sequence (core old / young).
倒置只改地表高低，不改构造——层序不变。: Inversion changes only surface height, not the structure; the sequence stays the same.
去掉这一步：学生只会背名词，拿到一段没标注的剖面就判不出。: Skip this step and students only memorize terms, unable to interpret an unlabeled cross-section.
考核：能同时说出「这是水平位移（岩层被错断不升降）」与「高差为正说明还没倒置」。: Check: be able to say both "this is horizontal displacement (layers offset, no rise or fall)" and "a positive height difference means not yet inverted".
水平位移的断层把岩层错断而不升降；倒置与否只看背斜轴部与向斜槽部的高差符号。: A horizontally displaced fault offsets layers without raising or lowering them; whether relief is inverted depends only on the sign of the height difference between anticline axis and syncline trough.
facts B2.1 ⑤、B3 第 1 / 10 行、B4 D4/D6: facts B2.1 ⑤, B3 rows 1 / 10, B4 D4/D6
剥蚀时间 — 背斜与向斜的高差: Erosion time — height difference between anticline and syncline
断层调成水平位移、错开 ≥ 120 m，背斜仍更高: Fault set to horizontal displacement, offset ≥ 120 m, anticline still higher
错开量靠「水平错距」，倒置与否看「背斜轴部 − 向斜槽部」的正负: Offset comes from "horizontal offset"; inversion depends on the sign of "anticline axis − syncline trough"
强大挤压力下岩层发生塑性变形: Rock layers deform plastically under powerful compression
关于背斜与向斜，正确的是: Which statement about anticlines and synclines is correct?
背斜向上拱起、向斜向下弯曲: Anticlines arch upward, synclines bend downward
两者与岩层弯曲无关: Neither has anything to do with bending layers
背斜的岩层新老关系是: The age relationship of layers in an anticline is
核部与两翼无法判断: Cannot tell between core and limbs
图 2.15 图面（背斜核部老、两翼新）＋ 图注「①最老、⑦最新」（A2.2 #: Fig. 2.15 (anticline core old, limbs young) + caption "① oldest, ⑦ youngest" (A2.2 #6, A5 #8).
背斜顶部被压塌: The anticline crest collapses under pressure
背斜顶部受张力产生裂隙、易被侵蚀；向斜槽部岩层致密、不易被侵蚀: The anticline crest fractures under tension and erodes easily; the syncline trough has dense rock that resists erosion
断层把背斜错断了: A fault has cut the anticline
与岩层无关: Has nothing to do with rock layers
下列属于断块山的是: Which of these are fault-block mountains?
A2.3 #3（p.28）：上升的岩块常成为断块山或高地，如华山、庐山、泰山；A: A2.3 #3 (p.28): raised blocks often become fault-block mountains or highlands, such as Huashan, Lushan and Taishan; A5 #6.
渭河平原、汾河谷地的成因是: The Weihe Plain and Fenhe Valley were formed by
相对下降的岩块形成的谷地或低地: Valleys or lowlands formed by relatively dropped blocks
断层沿线为什么常发育沟谷、河流？: Why do ravines and rivers often develop along faults?
断层自己挖出了沟: The fault dug the ravine itself
沿线岩石破碎、易受风化侵蚀: Rock along the fault is broken and easily weathered and eroded
断层处岩层更硬: Rock layers are harder at faults
看懂岩层怎么被挤弯、怎么被蚀成倒置、又怎么被切断错开。: See how rock layers are squeezed into bends, eroded into inverted relief, and cut and offset.
